={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $env.DDP_EMAIL_FROM || 'Donum Dei Performance <programs@donumdeiperformance.com>', to: [$json.email], subject: 'You are enrolled — how the practice works', text: $json.name + ',

You have joined at the ' + $json.tier + ' level. Welcome to the practice.

What happens now: the engine builds your week from your assessment — schedule, fatigue, equipment, injuries — and every program clears a hard quality-control gate before it reaches you. Nervous-system load is managed. Movement coverage is complete. You will never be sent training to failure on a primary lift.

Your first program is on its way. Read it in full before your first session. The block order is deliberate: Warmup, Power, Strength, Accessory, Core, Mobility. Follow it as written.

One instruction for this week: do less than you think you should, and do it exactly. Precision compounds. Excess does not.

Donum Dei. The body is a gift. Train it accordingly.

— Donum Dei Performance · Riz Management LLC' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $env.DDP_EMAIL_FROM || 'Donum Dei Performance <programs@donumdeiperformance.com>', to: [$('Prepare').item.json.email], subject: 'The one habit that makes the engine work', text: $('Prepare').item.json.name + ',

Three days in. The system only adapts if you tell it the truth.

Every Sunday you will get a check-in: fatigue on a 0–5 scale, sessions completed, anything that hurt. Sixty seconds. That check-in is not admin — it is the input the engine uses to decide whether next week progresses, holds, or deloads. Skip it and next week is a guess. Complete it and next week is precise.

There is no penalty for a hard week honestly reported. There is a real cost to a hard week hidden. Report accurately and the programming protects you.

Donum Dei. The body is a gift. Train it accordingly.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $env.DDP_EMAIL_FROM || 'Donum Dei Performance <programs@donumdeiperformance.com>', to: [$('Prepare').item.json.email], subject: 'One week in — the horizon is decades, not days', text: $('Prepare').item.json.name + ',

You have completed a week. Whatever it felt like, you have started something the practice measures in decades.

The objective hierarchy never reorders: joint integrity first, then movement quality, then strength, then work capacity, then hypertrophy, then sport. Most training inverts this and pays for it later. This practice does not.

If anything is unclear — a movement, a constraint, a decision the engine made — reply to this email or use the Correspondence page. A question is answered in your own words, not routed to a bot.

Hold the standard. The results are downstream of the standard.

Donum Dei. The body is a gift. Train it accordingly.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: '82f1b617-35af-423c-9780-65166c39adc4' }, properties: { 'Event': { title: [{ text: { content: 'Onboarding sequence completed: ' + $('Prepare').item.json.email } }] }, 'Workflow': { select: { name: 'checkin-reminder' } }, 'Status': { select: { name: 'success' } }, 'Detail': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: 'Days 0/3/7 delivered.' } }] } } }) }}
